title: Aza e Hussain
body:
hikayat ishq ki jaari rahegi
shaoor o rooh par taari rahegi
zamane ke yazeedon ko batado
qayamat tak azadari rahegi
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain walon ki tarze wafa aza e hussain
yazeed waale mitayenge kya aza e hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hamein ye tarz e ibadat hai jaan se pyari
ye ghar ye maal ye aulad is pe sab waari
hamare khoon ki gardish mein hai azadari
butool e paak ke dil ki dua aza e hussain
hussain walon ki tarze...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo kat gaya hai wo sookha gala na bhoolenge
jo lut gayi wo muqadas rida na bhoolenge
qasam khuda ki kabhi karbala na bhoolenge
hamara jeena hai majlis buka aza e hussain
hussain walon ki tarze...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo raah e kufa ke aalaam kis tarha bhoole
yazeed o shimr ke iqdaam kis tarha bhoole
ye bhool jaaye magar shaam kis tarha bhoole
sha'aar abid e bemaar ka aza e hussain
hussain walon ki tarze...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan mein aaye hai hum karbala ka gham lekar
jahan se jayenge ek roz chashm e nam lekar
marenge haath mein abbas ka alam lekar
karenge qabr mein jaa kar bapa aza e hussain
hussain walon ki tarze...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye gham bayad e shah e mashraqain zindabad
ye shor e majlis o matam ye bain zindabad
sada lagao aza e hussain zindabad
karenge aur bhi ahle aza aza e hussain
hussain walon ki tarze...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaban pe nauha hai akbar ki naujawani ka
dilon mein dard hai asghar ki bezabani ka
wo jin ko mil na saka ek ghoont pani ka
batao kyun na kare ham bhala aza e hussain
hussain walon ki tarze...
<<DIVIDER>>
jise hai zulm se nafrat wo karbalayi hai
jo haq ka chaahne waala hai apna bhai hai
yazeedi fikr se apni faqat ladayi hai
kisi bhi shakl mein ho bapa aza e hussain
hussain walon ki tarze...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo qaidi jis ne aza ka ye beej boya hai
wo jisne tauq e garan aansuon se dhoya hai
tadap tadap ke jo chalees saal roya hai
usi se pooch musadiq hai kya aza e hussain
hussain walon ki tarze...
author: Musadiq Lakhani
